title: Part 2 Readiness Reassessment — Scorecard & Executive Decision

higher_order_inventory.finding: 0.4% Analyze, 0% Evaluate, 0% Very Difficult. Only 10 Analyze items in 2,540 pool. No learner can practice higher-order skills.
higher_order_inventory.evidence: S835 cognitive scan — direct grep across 5 packs

difficulty_distribution.finding: 96.8% of items at Apply/Understand. 48.3% Moderate. 4.4% Difficult. 0% Very Difficult. CAQS targets require 25% Difficult + 10% Very Difficult.

content_variety.finding: Heavy template-rotation origin. 52.8% of defect classes trace to single pipeline. MCQ-dominant (2,500 items); 90 case items are uniform Moderate.
content_variety.evidence: S836 defect origin analysis; 36 defect classes

part_2_readiness.finding: Zero Part 2 items exist. No Part 2 blueprint mapping performed. No Part 2 domain expertise established.
part_2_readiness.evidence: Pack file scan — all QIDs are Part 1 prefix

authoring_readiness.status: PROMISING — pipeline designed, not yet validated

pipeline_design.finding: S836 6-stage quality-first pipeline is fully specified with defined quality gates at each stage. Addresses all 19 template-origin defect classes.

defect_prevention.finding: Pipeline gates prevent 19 defect classes by design. But 13 non-template defect classes (author errors, code defects, process errors) require separate handling.
defect_prevention.evidence: S836 defect origin analysis; 36 defect classes mapped to prevention

pipeline_validation.finding: Pipeline has NOT been validated. 50-item pilot is designed but not executed. Zero items produced by new pipeline.

authoring_velocity.finding: Velocity estimates exist (15-35 min/item) but are theoretical. Real velocity unknown until S836 Sprint 1 pilot completes.
authoring_velocity.evidence: S837 resource model — all times are estimated

blueprint_readiness.status: ADEQUATE for Part 1; not yet assessed for Part 2

part_1_coverage.finding: All 6 Part 1 domains have content. Sections A-D have Certified content. Sections E-F have partial Certified coverage. 90.5% of pool Certified.

los_mapping.finding: Items carry LOSTag, Topic, and CognitiveLevel metadata. But systematic mapping to specific IMA Learning Outcome Statements is inconsistent — template labels predominate.
los_mapping.evidence: S835 cognitive scan — 50.2% Understand suggests template-based labeling

part_2_blueprint.finding: Part 2 blueprint domains identified (Financial Statement Analysis, Corporate Finance, Decision Analysis, Risk Management, Investment Decisions, Professional Ethics). But no detailed LOS mapping or content-authoring guide exists.
part_2_blueprint.evidence: S837 sprint plan — Part 2 domains listed, not mapped

cross_part_alignment.finding: Part 1 → Part 2 conceptual bridges exist (CVP → capital budgeting, variance analysis → performance evaluation, cost management → decision analysis). Blueprint structure supports cross-part items.
cross_part_alignment.evidence: Taxonomy registry; formula master; decision tree documents

expansion_readiness.status: PLANNED — sprint structure exists, not yet executed

sprint_structure.finding: 4-sprint structure with clear deliverables, batches, and resource estimates. 28 batches across 12 weeks. Governance-compliant (≤30 items/batch).

resource_planning.finding: 322 hours estimated. Time-per-item model built. Risk-adjusted estimates range from 258-580 hours. But all estimates are theoretical.

governance_guard.finding: Governance guard 32/32 PASS. Rules 2, 3, 5, 6 (BLOCK) active. Rules 1, 4 (WARN) active. Test suite verified. Pipeline gating integrated with governance guard.

defect_risk_posture.finding: Defect-prevention pipeline exists on paper. But the entire remediation history shows that actual authoring reveals defects design didn't anticipate. 53% of defect classes were discovered during remediation, not prevented during authoring. The pipeline may miss novel defect classes at Part 2 scale.
defect_risk_posture.evidence: DEFECT_LIBRARY.md — 36 defect classes, 19 from template pipeline

overall_readiness.explanation: Score decreased from S834 (65) because deeper analysis revealed that content maturity is even weaker than initially assessed (0% Evaluate, 0% Very Difficult, only 10 Analyze items). The authoring pipeline and sprint plan represent progress in readiness planning, but the pipeline is not yet validated — these are design artifacts, not proven capability. Score will increase when S836 Sprint 1 pilot validates the pipeline.

conditions_for_full_readiness: S836 Sprint 1 pilot must validate the quality-first pipeline with >= 85% first-pass certification rate
Sprint 1 velocity must confirm time-per-item estimates within 30% tolerance
Zero DL-008/DL-026/DL-013 violations in pilot cohort (proves defect prevention)
Part 2 blueprint must be fully mapped to specific Learning Outcome Statements
At least 100 Evaluate items must be in the Certified pool (0 currently)
At least 200 Analyze items must be in the Certified pool (10 currently)
Pipeline must demonstrate capability to produce 3+ items/hr sustained over a full sprint

phase_1_validate.gate: Pipeline must validate with >= 85% certification rate and zero defect-class violations

phase_2_assess.gate: If Sprint 1 validates, proceed to Sprint 2. If not, iterate pipeline.

phase_3_pilot_part2.action: Author first 50 Part 2 items using validated pipeline (Sprint 2-4 subset)
phase_3_pilot_part2.gate: 50 Part 2 items must pass same quality gates as Part 1 items

phase_4_expand.duration: After Phase 3 pilot validates Part 2 authoring capability

critical_risks.mitigation: Sprint 1 will establish real velocity baseline

critical_risks.risk: Evaluate item authoring proves infeasible at scale
critical_risks.impact: Part 2 expansion blocked — Evaluate items are core Part 2 requirement
critical_risks.mitigation: S836 pilot includes 10 Evaluate items to test feasibility early

critical_risks.risk: Novel defect classes emerge at Part 2 scale
critical_risks.mitigation: Apply all S836 gates without exception; log all new defect classes to DEFECT_LIBRARY.md

acceptable_risks: Part 1 content carries existing DL-013/DL-016/DL-026 residual — non-blocking for Part 2 work
Case study pool uniform difficulty — non-blocking for MCQ-focused Part 2 pilot
Pack C/D hash drift from S811 baseline — authorized post-S853 drift

confidence.pipeline_design_confidence: HIGH (95) — thorough specification addresses known defect causes
confidence.part_2_authoring_confidence: LOW (30) — no Part 2 blueprint expertise, no Part 2 items authored
confidence.overall_confidence: MODERATE (55) — pipeline is sound on paper; execution gap is the primary risk

comparison_s834.explanation: S834 assessed readiness broadly. S838's deeper analysis revealed the content maturity deficit is more severe (0% Evaluate, 0.4% Analyze vs. assumed 'low but present'). The -11 point drop reflects more accurate assessment, not regression. The pipeline design and sprint plan represent genuine progress — but they are plans, not capability.

governance_verification.hash_verification: 3 of 5 packs match S811 baseline (A, B, E); 2 drifted (C, D — post-S853)
